parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello, I heard your advert on the radio about the sale you're having, and I wanted to find out about your cars.

Well you've called the right place, so how much do you want to spend?

I'd like to spend about $4,000, but definitely no more than $4,300.

Okay, for that price we've got some nice cars. I've got a lovely Noda. Do you know that model?

Yes, what color is it? I know it sounds unimportant, but there are certain colors I don't want.

Well this one is silver.

That's good, because I don't want a dark color, like black, as they get too hot in summer. So is it in good condition?

It's just had a state-of-the-art stereo put in, and although one light is damaged, we'd repair that for you if you decided to buy it.

Oh, that's good of you.

I've also got a Camina. It's a white one. It's slightly more expensive than the Noda, but it's a good car. I know it quite well because it was owned by our manager here, so I used to get to drive it quite a bit.

The Camina is okay, but it's a little on the big side.

Well, how about a Telster? They're smaller, but not too small. We've got an orange one of those. Actually, what kind of model were you after? This one's an automatic.

Great. They are so much easier to drive than the manual model, although I'm fine with either.

And another good feature is that the previous owner only replaced its tires last month.

That will save some money, and anything to do with the wheels is so important for safety. It might be worth a look.

Okay. Now, let's look at what else we've got in your price range. How about an Alba? It's a red one. It's the newest of the cars for sale in your bracket.

How old is it? I doubt I could afford anything less than 10 years old.

Well, you might be surprised. There was only one previous owner, and they had it eight years. All the others are at least nine years old.

Hmm. Now, that's a possibility.

Okay. Well, I’m interested in a couple of those. Could I come and take a look at them?

Sure. We’re open seven days a week. Do you know where we are?

I think so. You’re on Station Road in Mitchell, right? I usually go past your place when I’m on the bus.

That’s right. You can’t miss us. What day would suit you? Don’t leave it too long as these cars are likely to go quickly at these prices.

Well, I couldn’t get there before Wednesday, and even that might be pushing it. How does Thursday sound?

Sounds good. I usually don't work then or Fridays, but I am this week.

That’s good. I’d prefer to deal with you.

Okay, so would 9:30 in the morning be okay?

No worries. When you arrive, ask for Gerald Smith. That’s G-E-R-A-L-D.

Okay. Now, will you be coming by car or public transport?

I’ll probably come with my dad in his car. He knows all about this sort of thing.

Well, you should be able to park at the supermarket. Parking can be a bit hard with all the businesses around here and all our cars out the front.

Great. Now, is there anything I need to bring with me?

Let me think. If you want to take the car for a test drive, you’ll need to have identification with you.

I mean, otherwise you could just drive off in it and never come back.

Okay. That’s easy.

Perfect. See you later this week.

analyses.content: 录音中提到这辆 Noda 虽然安装了最先进的立体声，但有一个 light（车灯）是损坏的（damaged），对应题干 One ... is broken。
...and although one light is damaged, we'd repair that for you if you decided to buy it.
注意同义替换：原文中的 damaged（损坏的）对应题干中的 broken。
I know it quite well because it was owned by our manager here...
Belong to（属于）对应原文的 owned by（被...拥有），听到 owner 相关的表达时需重点定位。
销售员说他对这辆 Camina 很了解，因为它之前是由这里的 manager（经理）拥有的，对应题干 Used to belong to the...。
Actually, what kind of model were you after? This one's an automatic.
录音后文提到了 manual（手动挡），那是买家说自己也能开手动挡，但填空应填该车的具体属性 automatic。
关于 Telster 这辆车，销售员确认它是一个 automatic（自动挡）车型。
And another good feature is that the previous owner only replaced its tires last month.
注意 wheels（轮子）是后面提到的总结词，核心答案是具体部件 tires。
录音提到前任车主上个月刚给它换了 tires（轮胎），对应题干 Has got new...。
There was only one previous owner, and they had it eight years. All the others are at least nine years old.
不要填 10 或 9：10 是买家的心理预期，9 是其他车辆的最小岁数，只有 8 是该车的真实车龄。
关于红色的那辆 Alba，前任车主拥有了它 eight（八）年，对应题干 Only ... years old。
买家确认地址时问车行是不是在 Station Road，销售员表示正确。
I think so. You’re on Station Road in Mitchell, right?
路名首字母必须大写。注意不要被后面的地名 Mitchell 干扰，那是城镇名而非路名。
Well, I couldn’t get there before Wednesday... How does Thursday sound? Sounds good.
典型的“协商排除题”，录音中提到了 Wednesday, Thursday 和 Friday，最终商定的是 Thursday。
买家因时间冲突排除了周三，提议 Thursday（周四），销售员表示本周该日他刚好上班。
When you arrive, ask for Gerald Smith. That’s G-E-R-A-L-D.
注意首字母 G 的发音，不要误拼为 J。
销售员报出了自己的名字 Gerald，并进行了逐字母拼写：G-E-R-A-L-D。
Well, you should be able to park at the supermarket.
不要填 businesses，那是导致停车难的原因，而非建议停放的地点。
销售员建议买家将车停在附近的 supermarket（超市），因为车行门口车位很紧俏。
...if you want to take the car for a test drive, you’ll need to have identification with you.
该单词拼写较长，虽然口语常用 ID，但填空应写出录音中的完整形式。
销售员提示如果要进行试驾（test drive），买家必须随身携带 identification（身份证件）。
